page.overview:
What is The Quibbler?

The Quibbler, marketed as The Wizarding World's Alternative Voice, was a wizarding tabloid published and edited by Xenophilius Lovegood, father of Luna Lovegood. Luna gained every issue of The Quibbler when it was published, which often contributed to her eccentric beliefs.

The Quibbler published odd articles, including conspiracy theories and discussions of imaginary creatures; it also published Rita Skeeter's interview of Harry Potter on Lord Voldemort's return.

Publishing of The Quibbler started by the 1980s. The magazine published many ridiculous articles, such as those on the supposed existence of the Crumple-Horned Snorkack. At some point in or before 1987, the magazine had an article about a witch who did not know she was a werewolf.

Reading The Quibbler was part of sixth year Divination classes during the 1989–1990 school year, and seventh year classes during the 1990–1991 school year. There was at least one mention of Celestina Warbeck saying something, which students did not believe was something she actually said.
